_notes: All tuning lives here. Targets tuned with tests/sim.mjs + tools/tune.mjs (see README). Each throw draws handDraw dice and the player rolls rollCount of them. Set `antes` to an object like `antesExample` to switch to antes x blinds.

counters._notes: Binary counter dice (exotic). Raw binary values; Link counters chain adjacent counters to their left up to maxChainBits. Each shop slot first rolls shopChance for a counter (separate from specialChance, so classic specials keep their odds); which counter = shop.rarityWeights[rarity] x weight.

mods._notes: Modifier dice (Ruby, Ember, Last Call, Matching, Overcharged, Gold, Twin, Echo, Glass) on any shape d4–d20. Price = prices[shape] + priceAdd. Shop: a special roll picks the modifier by rarity, then its shape by shapeWeights. Gold pays goldPayout[shape] per die showing >= the Gold die's top face.

casino._notes: Casino d12 / d20 (exotic, G's rules, confirmed). Every face scores basePoints; the three slot faces also add faceMult[tag] mult (additive, like Ember); slot777 plays the JACKPOT. d12 = 9 plain + 3 slot faces, d20 = 17 plain + 3 slot faces. Own shop chance (shopChance, after the counters' share of the same roll); which one = shop.rarityWeights[rarity] x weight.

parity._notes: Odds & Evens (exotic): Odds d6 (1,3,5,7,9,11), Evens d6 (2..12), Parity Coin (scores 0, flips odd/even; every OTHER die whose scored value is non-zero and of that parity gets +addMult mult; several coins each apply). Own shop chance after counters and casino.
